title: US Market Reaction To Kevin Warsh's Speech: Nasdaq Falls 386 Pts; Dow, S&P 500 Down; Why Wall Street Is Down?
U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
body: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.

title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
body: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

title: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
body: Investors expect the Fed to pause rate hikes in October, but Kevin Warsh's rejection of traditional communications practices and continued concern about inflation leave the decision uncertain.
